name: Cropora - Field Intelligence Platform
tagline: Satellite-based field intelligence for Iowa cropland: rotation patterns, crop health and soil moisture.
problem: Farmers lack accessible multi-year field insight before a season.
solution: Analyses NASA vegetation and soil-moisture datasets and USDA crop maps from 2013–2023 to classify rotation, track phenology and flag risks.
demo_moment: Team-described: view a field's rotation history and health curve.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Sustainability Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Built solo on public satellite data.

lessons: Scope to one state's cropland to go deep.
